[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Ilsan Raetura''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] of nobility who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Raetura was acquainted with [[Bab Esrus]],<ref name="SWG:BE" /> a [[Sculptor/Legends|biosculptor]]<ref name="SWG:HWNGS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Help With Naboo Gallery Show}}</ref> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="SWG:BE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Esrus hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to delivere a cage containing a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] with multicolored [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to Ilsan Raetura. During the delivery, they were attacked by a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] but the individual was able to eliminate the aggressor and protect Lady Raetura.<ref name="SWG:BE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Lady Ilsan Raetura]]
Lady Ilsan Raetura was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Ilsan Raetura spawned under the generic "noble" template, her [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and appearance were randomized under one of a 42 possible depictions during each server reset. Lady Ilsan Raetura was involved in the third quest given by Bab Esrus on Naboo. However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:BE" /><ref name="NabooMap">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=55618.html|text=Attach to the Labeled Naboo Map: All Static missions for Naboo}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref>
